provenance.statement: Partial historical-provisional 0/31/0 allocation: 31 allocated, 20 unspent; not optimized or complete and not current-client certified. Exactly eleven reconciled Combat keys, no filler, automatic completion or lowered gates. Removing Adrenaline Rush yields legal 0/30/0 with 21 unspent; other legal underallocations remain allowed. Source parent pointers use the existing local full-parent rank convention. Strict Precision has cap 3; legacy cap 5 and direct presets remain unchanged. Fixed sword/sword, bothWeaponsDaggers=false, one target, no incoming attacks or utility. Lightning Reflexes is inactive without incoming attacks; Puncturing Wounds is inactive because neither Backstab nor Mutilate executes. Endurance is inactive without Sprint/Evasion utility: source cooldown reductions are 30/60 percent, while legacy runtime retains 10/20 percent; no Endurance mechanical correctness is claimed. Blade Flurry haste executes, but cleave is inactive against one target. Dual Wield Specialization off-hand penalty/AP composition, Hack and Slash proc eligibility/order/AP, fixed priority, weapon/ability coefficients, hit/crit/armor and tuning remain provisional. Flawless Execution dynamically changes Eviscerate cost; configured preview does not guarantee later costs or immediate eligibility. Maximum Energy is 100; starting Energy is separate. Baseline Health overrides fallback Health; primary/AP/Health contributions are not applied twice. Raw preview hit/crit is not final roll chance; Precision is applied by the existing hit resolver. No modifiers, catalog items/enchants, custom priorities or batches.
